content: Atman is the individual self or soul, the innermost essence of a person. According to the Upanishads, Atman is identical with Brahman, the ultimate reality. The Taittiriya Upanishad teaches that Atman is the Supreme Self, the source of all existence, described as pure consciousness and bliss beyond the scope of speech and thought.
